title: Page 2
slug: 仇人逼我嫁-芳妮-孟佳梨没想到当年老被她保护的小胖子竟变成眼前的帅哥总裁-他曾发誓以后换他保护她可现在欺负她最狠的就是他
content_zh:
“汪汪汪—”孟宝宝在她身边绕圈圈，讨好的在她腿边蹭了蹭，表情可爱又无辜。

那男的一副凶神恶煞的模样，它小小狗儿怎么有办法对抗啊？

“哼，没义气的家伙。”孟佳梨不满的嗔了声，不过看向爱犬的目光却是宠溺的。唉，都是她宠出来的，怪不了谁。“走，咱们回家吧，下回不要乱找“玩具”了。”将方才替男人简单处理的急救物品收好，她挥挥手。

“汪汪！”孟宝宝忙不迭的回应，一个蹦跳朝回去的方向冲。

看着它金黄色的身躯在林间愉悦的奔跑，孟佳梨也忍不住咧开了唇，心情跟着轻松起来，举步跟上，决定把方才短暂的插曲抛在脑后。

不过，刚刚那男人离开时好像说了什么……很快会再见之类的话语？

不对，应该是她听错了吧，毕竟刚刚噪音这么大，谁听得清楚他在说什么，根本就是个莫名其妙的男人。

算了，管他这么多，反正以后也不会再见面。

孟佳梨扯扯背包，朝一溜烟又不知道跑到哪去的狗儿喊道：“孟宝宝，别又乱跑了啊！”

“欸，镇尾那个老王昨天被老婆打出门，说偷偷在外面藏了个女人，连儿子都生了咧。”

“我家隔壁的陈家大儿子啊，听说因为老婆一直生不出来离婚了。”

“唉，最近鸡下的蛋少了很多，一定是太吵了，吓到我的鸡了。”

“镇上这阵子来了不少外地人，东晃西晃的，也不知道是来干什么？”

“我儿子他啊……”

在护士，木门开阖间，可以看到外头小小的候诊室中坐满了人，正三三两两悠闲的话家常。

这就是她每日看诊时的风景，没了教学医院紧凑沉重的节奏，多了缓慢轻松的步调，毕竟留在镇上的大部分都是老弱妇孺，年轻人都外出打拚了，小镇上的诊所也成了这些彼此熟识的邻居们打发时间的好地方。

“柳婶，哪里不舒服？”孟佳梨将瞟向诊间外的视线收回，放到了刚走进来的老妇人身上，精致的五官带着温和的笑容。

“唉，还不是老毛病，这浑身就是不对劲，晚上也睡不好。”柳婶走向诊桌前坐好，边说边用手在身上四处捶了捶。

“你有乖乖听我的话，每天去爬爬山、散散步吗？”孟佳梨放下手上的笔，笑咪咪的看着柳婶。

“我这把老骨头已经浑身不舒服了，哪有办法爬山啦。”柳婶圆圆胖胖的脸闪过心虚，但很快为自己的偷懒找到借口。

“柳婶，你还很年轻呢，而且活动活动对身体是有益处的，不然你先乖乖听话，然后我们再来看看要怎么调整药物。”其实这柳婶健康得很，只是太寂寞了，才会每天找借口上诊所看病，找人聊天。

“好啊好啊，对了，你知道吗—”柳婶点点头，随即跟以往一样，马上把话题转到跟生病不相干的琐事上，从家中漏水到天气阴晴都说了一遍之后，还没有停止的迹象。

孟佳梨耐着性子，微笑点着头。

她刚开始到这小诊所看诊时，对这样的医病关系还有点不适应，毕竟过去在大医院，看诊的速度是分秒必争，哪有闲情逸致听病人说些风马牛不相干的杂事，所以她总是公事公办，迅速解决问题，然后将病人请出诊间。

可是没想到那样有效率的看诊方式却造成反弹，反而没有人想挂她的门诊，害得找她返乡行医的学长杨子谦每天满诊，大喊吃不消，私下找她解释了这里的“医风”之后，她才领悟到为何自己闲得发慌，而杨子谦却每天累到趴。

之后她逐渐找回幼时住在小镇里的节奏，也发现这小诊所最大的功用就是医心，也就从善如流，融入了小诊所原本慵懒却温馨的氛围中，从此她成了老人们最喜欢的“美女医师”，即便没病，他们也总要找个借口前来跟她聊聊，彷佛这样才算是度过了完整的一天。

“欸，医生，你知道镇上最近来了很多外地人吗？”柳婶突然压低声音，身子微微向前，好似在说什么大秘密。

孟佳梨怔愣了几秒，脑海中突然闪过那张阴沉俊美的男人脸庞，心不知为何漏跳了一拍。

“你不知道吧？我听我儿子说，那些人是他们公司派来勘查的高级干部。”柳婶满意的看着孟佳梨茫然的表情。

“勘查？”如果她没记错的话，柳婶总是挂在嘴边引以为傲的儿子，是在台北有名的集团工作，旗下包括休闲饭店等观光事业。

“嘘，这我只跟医生你一个人说喔，我儿子说，他们公司想在这里盖度假村。”柳婶将声音压得更低了。

孟佳梨眉心微拢，随即舒展开来，“知道了。”之前也曾经有别的财团看上这里幽静秀美的景致与不曾开发的自然质朴，试图在这里大兴土木，盖观光休闲度假村，可却被老一辈的镇民给严拒，看样子这次也不会例外。

他们对自己的家乡拥有深厚的感情，若首肯了观光开发，就代表将迎来一连串破坏水土保持，改变自然生态环境，吵杂拥挤又垃圾四散的未来。

真正爱家乡的人，是不会愿意为了赚钱而毁坏这一片宛若人间仙境的乐土。

第1章(2)

“柳婶，回去记得多走动走动，有什么问题再回诊。”她温婉的表示看诊结束。

柳婶还没尽兴，嘴巴一开，又想继续说时，一旁的护士董文芳早一步上前扶起人，笑咪咪的将她往外带，边说边

“欸，我还没—”

“赵伯伯该您了。”不顾柳婶的离情依依，董文芳扭头就往外喊。

“来喽。”男人苍老干涩的声音随之扬起，柳婶再不愿意，也只有摸摸鼻子退出诊间。

“赵伯伯，今天感觉怎样？”孟佳梨看向老人的目光更温暖了，过去她的父亲忙着赚钱给母亲治病，所以她的童年有好大一部分时间是由柳婶和赵伯伯这两户邻居陪伴照顾的。

“就是小咳嗽，咳咳，没什么大碍。”赵伯伯的态度平和斯文，眉宇间有股读书人的气质，看得出年轻时应该也是个俊秀的知识分子。

孟佳梨站起身，拿起听诊器贴上了老人的胸口倾听半晌，又绕到他背后，用同样的步骤检查了一遍，“除了咳嗽之外，还有什么不舒服吗？”

赵伯伯想了想，手按向自己的腰侧，“最近睡觉时背有点酸痛，咳咳咳……一阵一阵的，白天就好很多。”

孟佳梨点点头，坐回座位道：“赵伯伯，我先安排你照一下胸部Ｘ光，我们来看看为什么咳嗽这么久都没改善。”

“不用了，只是小感冒，咳咳咳。”他摆摆手，不以为意的道。

“就当健康检查嘛，很快的。”孟佳梨放柔声音劝着。

“真的不用了，反正我老伴去了这么久，真要有什么，刚好让我去陪她。”赵伯伯扯扯唇，一派豁达。

“赵伯伯—”

“佳梨，你赵妈妈以前就说你漂亮又聪明，长大一定成就不凡。”赵伯伯突然话锋一转，视线穿过了孟佳梨，彷佛看向遥远之处，“如果她能亲眼看到你变成一个大医生，还甘愿待在镇上行医，一定会很安慰，可惜……”

想到那总是带着和蔼笑容的福气脸庞，昔日回忆如浪潮般涌入脑中，孟佳梨的心也跟着酸了起来。
content_en:
"Woof woof woof -" Meng Baobao circled around her and rubbed her legs flatteringly, with a cute and innocent expression.

That man looked so fierce, how could his little puppy fight against him?

"Huh, you're such a heartless guy." Meng Jiali snarled dissatisfiedly, but she looked at her pet dog with doting eyes.Alas, it was all her fault, no one can blame her."Let's go home. Don't look for "toys" next time." She put away the first-aid items that she had just handled for the man and waved her hand.

"Woof woof!" Meng Baobao responded hurriedly, jumping up and rushing back.

Seeing its golden body running happily in the forest, Meng Jiali couldn't help but grinned her lips, her mood became more relaxed, she followed up, and decided to put the short episode behind her.

However, the man seemed to have said something when he left just now...see you soon or something like that?

No, she must have heard wrongly. After all, the noise was so loud just now. Anyone who could hear clearly what he was talking about would be an incomprehensible man.

Forget it, don’t worry about him, we won’t see each other again anyway.

Meng Jiali tugged at her backpack and shouted to the dog, which was running away without knowing where it was: "Baby Meng, stop running around again!"

"Hey, the old man at the end of the town was kicked out by his wife yesterday, saying that he secretly hid a woman outside and even gave birth to a son."

"The eldest son of the Chen family next door to me, I heard that he got divorced because his wife never gave birth."

"Well, the chickens have laid a lot less eggs recently. It must be too noisy and scared my chickens."

"There are a lot of outsiders coming to town these days, wandering around here and there. I don't know what they are here for?"

"My son..."

In the nurse room, when the wooden door is opened and closed, you can see that the small waiting room outside is full of people, chatting leisurely in twos and threes.

This was the scene when she was seeing a doctor every day. Instead of the compact and heavy rhythm of the teaching hospital, there was a slow and relaxed pace. After all, most of the people who stayed in the town were the old, weak, women and children, and the young people had gone out to work hard. The clinic in the small town had become a good place for these neighbors who knew each other well to spend time.

"Aunt Liu, what's wrong with you?" Meng Jiali looked away from the outside of the clinic and focused on the old woman who had just walked in, with a gentle smile on her delicate features.

"Oh, it's not an old problem. There's just something wrong with my whole body, and I can't sleep well at night." Aunt Liu walked to the clinic table and sat down. As she spoke, she thumped her body with her hands.

"Have you listened to me and gone hiking and taking a walk every day?" Meng Jiali put down the pen in her hand and looked at Aunt Liu with a smile.

"My old bones are already feeling uncomfortable. There is no way I can climb the mountain." A guilty conscience flashed across Aunt Liu's round and chubby face, but she quickly found an excuse for her laziness.

"Aunt Liu, you are still very young, and moving is good for your body. Otherwise, please be obedient first, and then we will see how to adjust the medicine." In fact, Aunt Liu is very healthy, but she is too lonely, so she makes excuses to go to the clinic every day to see a doctor and find someone to chat with.

"Okay, okay, by the way, you know -" Aunt Liu nodded, and then, as usual, she immediately changed the topic to trivial matters that had nothing to do with illness. After talking about everything from water leakage at home to cloudy weather, there was no sign of stopping.

Meng Jiali patiently smiled and nodded.

When she first came to this small clinic for treatment, she was still a little uncomfortable with this kind of doctor-patient relationship. After all, in the past, in big hospitals, every minute was a must for consultation, and she had no time to listen to patients talk about irrelevant things. Therefore, she was always business-like, solving problems quickly, and then inviting the patients out of the clinic.

However, she didn't expect that such an efficient medical treatment method would cause a backlash. Instead, no one wanted to see her in the clinic. As a result, Yang Ziqian, the senior who returned to her hometown to practice medicine, was full of consultations every day and complained that he couldn't bear it. After explaining the "medical style" here to her in private, she realized why she was so idle, but Yang Ziqian was so tired every day.

After that, she gradually regained the rhythm of living in a small town when she was a child. She also discovered that the biggest function of this small clinic was to heal people, so she followed suit and integrated into the original lazy but warm atmosphere of the small clinic. From then on, she became the favorite "beautiful doctor" of the elderly. Even if they were not sick, they would always find an excuse to come and chat with her, as if this was a complete day.

"Hey, doctor, did you know that a lot of outsiders have come to this town recently?" Aunt Liu suddenly lowered her voice and leaned forward slightly, as if she was telling a big secret.

Meng Jiali was stunned for a few seconds, and the gloomy and handsome man's face suddenly flashed in her mind, and her heart skipped a beat for some reason.

"You don't know, right? I heard from my son that those people were senior cadres sent by their company to investigate." Aunt Liu looked at Meng Jiali's confused expression with satisfaction.

"Inspection?" If she remembered correctly, the son Aunt Liu was always proud of worked for a well-known group in Taipei, including leisure hotels and other tourism businesses.

"Shh, I'm only telling you this, doctor. My son said that their company wants to build a resort here." Aunt Liu lowered her voice.

Meng Jiali's eyebrows slightly furrowed, then relaxed, "I know." Previously, other consortiums had taken a fancy to the quiet and beautiful scenery and undeveloped natural simplicity here, and tried to build a tourist resort here, but they were severely rejected by the older generation of townspeople, and it seemed that this time would be no exception.

They have deep feelings for their hometown. If they approve the tourism development, it means that they will usher in a future that will destroy soil and water conservation, change the natural ecological environment, be noisy, crowded, and littered with garbage.

People who truly love their hometown will not be willing to destroy this paradise like a paradise on earth just to make money.

Chapter 1(2)

"Aunt Liu, please remember to walk around more when you go back. If you have any questions, come back for a consultation." She said gently that the consultation was over.

Aunt Liu hadn't finished her fun yet. When she opened her mouth and wanted to continue talking, the nurse Dong Wenfang stepped forward to help her up and took her out with a smile while talking.

"Hey, I haven't—"

"Uncle Zhao, it's your turn." Regardless of Aunt Liu's separation, Dong Wenfang turned around and called out.

"Here you go." The man's old and dry voice rose up. No matter how unwilling Aunt Liu was, she could only touch her nose and exit the clinic.

"Uncle Zhao, how do you feel today?" Meng Jiali looked at the old man with warmer eyes. In the past, her father was busy making money to treat her mother's illness, so she spent a large part of her childhood being cared for by her two neighbors, Aunt Liu and Uncle Zhao.

"It's just a small cough, cough, nothing serious." Uncle Zhao's attitude was gentle and gentle, and he had the temperament of a scholar between his brows. It could be seen that he must have been a handsome intellectual when he was young.

Meng Jiali stood up, picked up the stethoscope and put it on the old man's chest and listened for a long time. Then she went around behind him and checked again with the same steps. "Besides the cough, do you feel any discomfort?"

Uncle Zhao thought for a while and put his hand on his waist, "Recently, my back has been a little sore when I was sleeping, cough, cough, cough... it comes in waves, and it feels much better during the day."

Meng Jiali nodded, sat back and said, "Uncle Zhao, I'll arrange for you to take a chest X-ray first. Let's see why your cough hasn't improved for so long."

"No, it's just a little cold, cough, cough, cough." He waved his hand and said nonchalantly.

"Just treat it as a health check, it'll be quick." Meng Jiali advised in a soft voice.

"It's really not necessary. Anyway, my wife has been away for so long. If she really needs anything, she just wants me to accompany her." Uncle Zhao tugged his lips, looking open-minded.

"Uncle Zhao—"

"Jia Li, your mother Zhao said before that you are beautiful and smart, and you will definitely achieve great things when you grow up." Uncle Zhao suddenly changed the topic and looked past Meng Jia Li, as if looking into the distance. "If she could see you become a great doctor with her own eyes and be willing to stay in the town to practice medicine, she would be very comforted, but it's a pity..."

Thinking of that blessed face that always had a kind smile, memories of the past flooded into her mind like a wave, and Meng Jiali's heart became sour.
